prompts.prompt: Recreate the UI chrome in this reference as ONE transparent game HUD strip asset, isolated without the blue full-screen backdrop. Keep three adjoining elements in ONE horizontal row: left glossy cyan rounded-square reset button with the white clockwise arrow icon; center wide ivory/light-lavender beveled rounded rectangular goal panel with small dark-blue tab centered above it; right ivory/light-lavender rounded-square next panel with dark-blue tab above it. Faithfully match reference bright polished casual mobile game style, clean bevels and very subtle navy shadows. IMPORTANT erase ALL colored rings, all numbers, and ALL text including GOAL and NEXT. Goal panel must be blank for four live game counters; next panel blank for live ball. Only the reset arrow icon remains. Proportions: reset width 120, center panel width 400, next panel width 130, small 12 unit gaps; common panel height 115; tabs extend 25 units above. Entire row straight-on, level, all panels share baseline, generous transparent padding. True transparent background outside the individual pieces, no checkerboard, no background scene, no rings, no text, no extra decorations.

Recreate the BLUE GIFT BOX with GOLDEN YELLOW RIBBON and big plump satin BOW from this reference as one isolated transparent 3D cartoon game sprite. Remove all rings and background. Square bright cyan/royal-blue gift body, thick golden ribbon vertically down the front, shiny blue lid and slightly visible right side, large lustrous golden bow with two loops and two ribbon tails. Match the reference closely in material, highlights, rich blue color and rounded silhouette. IMPORTANT rotate the gift into an upright standing pose: vertical ribbon vertical, base horizontal, no tilted or diagonal box; game applies its own rotation. Orthographic-ish front view, very slight top/right depth only. Fill canvas with this one centered gift with safe transparent padding; entirely visible bow and body. No ground plane, no floor shadow, no text, no circles/rings, no background. True transparent alpha.

Match the soft puffy reference hand, no heavy black outline. Keep same pose and proportion. Remove every ring, arrow, red line and background entirely. The hand alone centered with safe transparent padding. No text, no background, no floor shadow, no extra fingers. Transparent alpha.
